Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately using [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/silverfox-2096/private-browser/security/advisories/new). See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/silverfox-2096/private-browser/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
Do not include keys, passwords, browser data, raw captures or private topology.

## What happened?

Describe the observed behavior and what you expected.

## How to reproduce

Give minimal, sanitized steps and the relevant commit or immutable image identity.

## Evidence and scope

Include sanitized errors/results. Distinguish a demonstrated failure from missing evidence, and a CI-built image from the running image. Note any relevant local changes.
